overall: The AG found that a Board member violated the Open Meeting Law by emailing a quorum of the Board about the flag dispute outside a posted meeting, and declined to review the personal-email allegation.

allegations.summary: A Board member allegedly emailed each fellow member about the flag dispute outside a posted meeting, which the complaint said was deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that Member Mills’s email related to a matter within the Board’s jurisdiction and reached more than a quorum of the Board.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged Board members use personal email addresses to conduct Board business.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25. Accordingly, we decline to review it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
